name: Entry
definition: Posting to an account that results in an increase or decrease to a balance.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Indicates whether an entry is a credit or a debit.

EntryDate.name: Entry Date
EntryDate.definition: Date and time at which an entry is posted to an account on the account servicer's books.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for an entry, as assigned by the account servicer.

AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification.name: Account Owner Transaction Identification
AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction as known by the account owner (or the instructing party managing the account).

AccountServicerTransactionIdentification.name: Account Servicer Transaction Identification
AccountServicerTransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction as known by the account servicer.

ReversalIndicator.name: Reversal Indicator
ReversalIndicator.definition: Indicates whether or not the entry is the result of a reversal.

ValueDate.name: Value Date
ValueDate.definition: Date and time assets become available to the account owner (in a credit entry), or cease to be available to the account owner (in a debit entry).

CommissionWaiverIndicator.name: Commission Waiver Indicator
CommissionWaiverIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the transaction is exempt from commission or not.

EntryType.name: Entry Type
EntryType.definition: Specifies the type of an entry in a report.

BankTransactionCode.name: Bank Transaction Code
BankTransactionCode.definition: Type of underlying transaction resulting in the entry.

Role.name: Role
Role.definition: Specifies the role played by a party or a system in the context of an entry in an account.

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Posting of an item to an account, that results in an increase or a decrease to the balance of the account.

Balance.name: Balance
Balance.definition: Amount that is the result of the sum of the entries from or to an account.
